import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan = new Room[10][10];

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Room() {
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            Arrays.fill(infected, false);
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (timestamp <= t && accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (!infected[timestamp]) return;
            setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
        }
    }

    static class PushRelabel {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        int N, s, t;
        List<List<Edge>> g;
        int[] height, excess, current;
        boolean[] inQueue;
        Queue<Integer> active;

        PushRelabel(int n) {
            N = n;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            height = new int[n];
            excess = new int[n];
            current = new int[n];
            inQueue = new boolean[n];
            active = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int to, int cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), 0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(to).add(b);
        }

        void enqueue(int v) {
            if (v != s && v != t && excess[v] > 0 && !inQueue[v]) {
                inQueue[v] = true;
                active.add(v);
            }
        }

        void push(int u, Edge e) {
            int d = Math.min(excess[u], e.cap);
            if (d == 0) return;
            e.cap -= d;
            g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
            excess[u] -= d;
            excess[e.to] += d;
            enqueue(e.to);
        }

        void relabel(int u) {
            int minHeight = 2 * N;
            for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                if (e.cap > 0) {
                    minHeight = Math.min(minHeight, height[e.to]);
                }
            }
            height[u] = minHeight + 1;
        }

        void discharge(int u) {
            while (excess[u] > 0) {
                if (current[u] == g.get(u).size()) {
                    relabel(u);
                    current[u] = 0;
                } else {
                    Edge e = g.get(u).get(current[u]);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && height[u] == height[e.to] + 1) {
                        push(u, e);
                    } else {
                        current[u]++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            s = source;
            t = sink;
            final int INF = 1000000000;
            height[s] = N;
            excess[s] = INF;
            for (Edge e : g.get(s)) {
                if (e.cap > 0) {
                    int d = e.cap;
                    e.cap = 0;
                    g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
                    excess[s] -= d;
                    excess[e.to] += d;
                    enqueue(e.to);
                }
            }
            while (!active.isEmpty()) {
                int u = active.poll();
                inQueue[u] = false;
                discharge(u);
            }
            return excess[t];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                else if (c == 'Z') floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                else floorplan[i][j].scientists = c - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        PushRelabel mf = new PushRelabel(n * n * (t + 1) + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    }
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0 && floorplan[i - 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i - 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1 && floorplan[i + 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i + 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0 && floorplan[i][j - 1].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j - 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1 && floorplan[i][j + 1].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j + 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.maxFlow(0, 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
